task_snapshots.title: Plan and decompose goal into tasks
task_snapshots.description:
## Goal
Tenn backend hardening pass (financial-engine_v2).

Deliverables:
1. Map the ingestion → extraction → persistence path for ASX filings; name files
   and entrypoints (no hand-wavy diagrams).
2. Run the project’s Python gates: ruff on touched paths, and pytest for
   financial-engine_v2/backend/tests and autodev/tests relevant to the change set.
3. Fix any concrete bug or regression you can prove with a failing test or log line;
   if out of scope, document as a tracked follow-up with file/line references.
4. Respect SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md: do not add forbidden fallbacks, parallel pipelines,
   or silent substitutions; fail-fast behaviour stays intact.

Out of scope:
- Schema migrations unless explicitly required by a proven bug.
- Changing embedding model / Qdrant collection without the embedding checklist.


## Budget
Max spend: $25.00

## Constraints
- Python 3.12+; ruff for lint; no black/isort in this repo.
- Canonical backend bootstrap: financial-engine_v2/scripts/run_local_backend.sh (agents).
- Cite paths and tests for claims; cite evidence or mark UNVERIFIED.
